review: V2 signed active lease cross-end review
method: Read-only source and project/script inspection; no builds, service operations, private key reads or live probes in this review
verdict: No major issue allowing incorrect authorization identified in reviewed paths

observations.detail: Both sides use 13 UTF8 lines joined by LF without trailing LF; product, active state, uppercase device, lowercase Guid D installation, decimal Steam text, nonce, actual effective token SHA256, three invariant decimal times, license kind and kid agree. RSA3072 SHA256 PKCS1 v1.5 is used on both sides.

Each activate/heartbeat Call copies the payload and replaces nonce with 16 CSPRNG bytes encoded as lowercase hex. Request context is captured before send. Stable request_id payload hash excludes nonce; successful retry keeps original session/lease but receives a fresh signature over request nonce. Invalid nonce is rejected before storage mutation.

Every active reply in real API send path is verified. Reply data is defensively copied and marker has private setter. Only located client Grant caller checks marker first. Coordinator checks generation and actual game identity before granting. Gate retains 0<delta<=60, request-start monotonic deadline and 1s deduction; heartbeat scheduling remains 28s.

Activation requires signed response token. Heartbeat hashes visible response token when present; otherwise actual request Bearer. Current server heartbeat includes its validated Bearer as response token, matching client effective token. Coordinator retains old token if heartbeat token omitted.

Initialization calls offline export using configured key directory and writes only public modulus/exponent/kid into three source constants. Build compiles project reference, then obfuscates compiled client and verifier; signing classes are not skipped. Runtime validates modulus length and derived kid and accepts only this single source pin. No HTTP key download/bootstrap observed.

PKCS8 key persists in KeyDirectory. Complete temp file is atomically moved without overwrite; concurrent initializer reuses winning file. Existing malformed or non3072 key fails without reset. Public-only offline exporter immediately returns and uses CreateNew output. Key backup and restricted directory ACL remain deployment responsibilities.

nonBlockingNotes.detail: Main added prechecks before build/protection: Modulus/Exponent/Kid constants must exist and be nonempty, modulus and exponent must decode as base64, modulus must be 384 bytes, exponent nonempty and kid must exactly match the first 16 lowercase hexadecimal characters of SHA256(modulus). Follow-up source read confirmed these checks. No rebuild or client binary modification was performed by reviewer; main states tested client binaries were unchanged.

Client requires exactly 17 decimal Steam characters; server accepts 1..20 decimal characters within UInt64. Wider server values are rejected by client context construction and do not create a signature bypass for normal 17-digit identities.

Windows key/temp files inherit KeyDirectory ACL. On Unix chmod0600 is applied after initial temporary write, so restricted parent directory/umask is the privacy precondition during creation. This does not affect signature agreement.

Server validates nonce syntax rather than tracking prior nonce values. Contract freshness is enforced by client fresh per-send randomness and verification against captured request context; captured response does not verify against new nonce. This matches current contract.

Rejected signature follows network-failure retry path; an already valid prior lease can remain usable only until its existing monotonic deadline. Invalid response does not update Grant or extend deadline.

notTestedInThisReview: Protected executable equivalence and runtime anti-tamper behavior
Live HTTP protocol or new replay injection against the running V2 service
Deployment key ACL values, private key contents or private configuration
Final delivery archive contents and executable hash provenance
scope: Only requested source/script review. Reports written only to evidence/signature-cross-review.json and reports/signature-cross-review.md. No source changes, builds, service operations or private .local reads.
